# Licenses of vendored assets

Every file in this directory is third-party code, committed verbatim or
pre-bundled from upstream packages. See `README.md` for what each file is and
how to regenerate it.

`motion.js` is a single upstream package. **`reactflow.js` is not**: it is an
esbuild bundle that inlines **17 npm packages** under three different licenses
(MIT, ISC and BSD-3-Clause). The inventory below is generated from esbuild's
metafile by `scripts/vendor-reactflow.sh`, which re-reads every version and
SPDX id from the real `package.json` files and warns when this table goes
stale. The license texts that follow are grouped **by family** — packages that
ship byte-identical text share one section, and every distinct copyright line
is reproduced.

`huu` is redistributed (npm tarball + GHCR image), so these notices ship with
it: ISC requires the copyright notice in all copies, BSD-3-Clause requires it
reproduced in binary distributions. The bundle is additionally built with
`--legal-comments=eof`, which keeps the upstream `@license` banners that exist
in the packages' own sources inside `reactflow.js` itself.
